name: XCustAnalysis
caption: Əlavə modullar / Müştərilər və uyğunluq / Müştəri analizi

datasets.name: Ods_cust
datasets.sql:
SELECT id as ID,cust_name as Tam_Adi ,lastname as Soyadi  ,firstname as Adi,patronymic  as Ata_Adi ,cust_type as Musteri_tipi from pcust_view p  where id in (select boorowerid from cm_portfolio)









order by id

datasets.name: Ods_girov
datasets.sql:
select g.pledgename,g.pledgeprice,anyinfotodisting,cardid,
(select description from cm_pledges where g. pledgeid=id) as pledges_name ,
(select name from cm_pledgsorts where g. pledgsorts=id) as pledgsorts_name  from cm_guarantee_credit g where 
g.creditid=:v_creditid

datasets.name: Ods_sedule
datasets.sql: select Rownum as NO,p.*,(p.PRINCIPAL+p.INTEREST) as TOTALPAY from cm_payment_schedule p where creditid=:v_creditid

datasets.name: Ods_portfol
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.dateofconclusion,p.numberofcredit,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.initialamount,p.annualyinterestrate,p.periodcontracts,
e.name as mutexsis,u.description as  maliye,a.name as verilme_meqsed,
h.rest,h.interestrest,h.duerest,h.dueinterestrest,h.penaltyrest,p.closedate,h.stopcalcdate,
pay.payedamt,pay.payedintamt,pay.payeddueamt,pay.payeddueintamt,pay.payedpenaltyamt,
payshed.principal,payshed.interest,(payshed.principal+payshed.interest)as ayod_cem,
cm_utils.Get_Gecgun(p.id,(sbop.get_date))as gec_gun
 from cm_portfolio p,cm_curr_state h,  cm_expert e, cm_usergroups u ,cm_aim_cred a,
 (select creditid,sum(payedamt) payedamt,sum(payedintamt) payedintamt,sum(payeddueamt)payeddueamt,sum(payeddueintamt)payeddueintamt,sum(payedpenaltyamt)payedpenaltyamt from cm_payments
group by creditid) pay,
(select creditid,sum(principal) principal,sum(interest) interest from cm_payment_schedule where paymentdate BETWEEN TRUNC(sbop.get_date, 'MONTH') and LAST_DAY(sbop.get_date)
group by creditid) payshed
 where p.id=h.creditid(+) 
  and p.expertid=e.id(+)
  and p.usrgroup=u.id(+)
  and p.id=pay.creditid(+)
  and p.id=payshed.creditid(+)
  and p.aim_id=a.id(+)
 and boorowerid=:v_boorowerid

datasets.name: Ods_payments
datasets.sql:
select*from cm_payments p where creditid=:v_creditid
ORDER BY PayDate DESC
